nom: Personal Day Everybody Stay Calm Recovery Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the mask leaves skin soft without adding shine, helps balance oiliness alongside BHA/benzoyl peroxide routines, and does not worsen breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the mask as hydrating and restorative, reviving flaky or dehydrated skin, though one found it not hydrating enough to notice a difference.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports it combats redness and dryness from seasonal changes.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin most often describe it as calming and non-irritating, soothing redness and reactions, though a couple report warmth, tingling, itchiness, or a burning sensation on application.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewer discusses aging specifically; comments focus on texture and glow rather than fine lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the mask meaningfully hydrates dry or flaky skin and revives tight, dehydrated skin overnight; one reviewer found it left skin drier and not soothed.
concerns.redness: The majority of reviewers citing redness report it visibly calms and reduces redness, including after peels, breakouts, eczema, or reactions; no dissent noted on this point.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a fine barrier reports the product burned on application and left skin drier; another with eczema reports it eased pain and itchiness without worsening flaking.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it after acne treatments or peels report smaller, calmer blemishes over time and reduced breakout-related redness; one notes possible purging with more breakouts the next day before improvement.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report the mask soothes active pimples and does not cause new breakouts; one long-time acne sufferer highlights it calms active spots specifically.
concerns.oiliness: A small number of reviewers with oily skin report it controls oiliness and leaves skin soft rather than shiny.

aspects.libelle: Cooling or tingling sensation on application
High price relative to product amount
Pairs well with resurfacing peel routine
Burning or itching on first use
Container feels underfilled for box size

extraits.texte: This unfortunately made my face feel warm upon first use which is never a good sign. My jaw was slightly itchy after so something in this product im sensitive too. Im assuming its one of the acids :( I had to return. If u want a calming mask check out Lush " catastrophe cosmetic", its my holy grail

I am not going through any skin concers at the moment (barrier is fine) but this products burned for a moment upon application. It also left my skin drier despite not having any majot actives and exfoliants. It did not fee like it left my skin soothed.

I love this mask. I have very oily skin and am acne-prone. So a fair amount of BHAs and Benzoyl Peroxide are a part of my routine. This has been the perfect add to help re-balance and quench my skin while still letting the harsher actives do their thing. Often, masks like these leave me too shiny. This one is perfect.

I have tried every product under the sun from prescription to high end skincare products and this mask exceeded my expectations! I have severe eczema, redness and irritation from breakouts and this literally calmed my entire face overnight. I will forever keep this mask as part of my skincare routine.

I have about 50 different wash-off masks, but I reach for this one the most often now. It's soothing and helps with any redness and any irritation from a breakout that I have. I have dry skin and this mask is hydrating enough that I can use it a few days a week.

I like to apply it right after I get out of the shower and it makes my skin so calm and smooth. I have combination acne prone skin and this has helped combat the redness and dryness that comes with the change in seasons.
I have dry skin and blackheads, so this is a mask for after I do an exfoliation treatment. It soothes how sensitive my skin feels after the resurfacing peel.
